why: one Actor, three SDKs, ONE descriptor — the JSON every SDK must emit for POST /api/actors and the orchestrator must store without loss. Each side asserts this file: runtime/go/registrar/conformance_test.go, tests/test_catalog_conformance.py, backend/src/catalog.conformance.test.ts
schemas: the input/output/params documents here are the DIALECT-NEUTRAL CORE of what each SDK derives — type, properties (each reduced to its own core) and required. Pydantic brands every schema with `title`, invopop's reflector with `$schema`/`$id`/`additionalProperties`, and neither branding is a contract: what the catalog reads is the property names and their JSON types. Each SDK's test projects its real emission down to this before comparing, and `required` is sorted because it is a set — its order is whichever order that language's author declared the fields in.

covers.multi-method: fetch/title/probe — ONE OPERATION PER METHOD (ADR 0023 §9), in declaration order
covers.per-method-signatures: title takes what fetch emits; a single Actor-level input/output pair could describe only one of them, and would typecheck every node against the other
covers.description: fetch carries the author's sentence (a Python docstring's first paragraph, a Go Does(...)); title and probe carry none and the key is ABSENT, never an empty string
covers.unset-schemas: probe declares neither takes nor emits — it registers and stays dispatchable, and simply advertises nothing
covers.params: run-wide config is ACTOR-level, so it rides EVERY operation including the one with no schemas of its own
covers.digest: the OCI image digest the worker self-registers (ADR 0011), from KONTRA_ACTOR_DIGEST in both SDKs
covers.source: the directory the WORKER loaded this actor from — on a fleet Machine `/opt/kontra/actor/<name>`, which is not a path on the reader's disk and is still the honest answer to where the code is

unsetDigest.why: a worker with no KONTRA_ACTOR_DIGEST OMITS the key. It is not an empty string: the catalog keeps a previously registered digest only when the key is ABSENT (`body.digest ?? prev.digest`), so a dev worker that posted "" would unpin the image on every restart
